projects.title: Asset Reconciliation and Data Quality ETL Pipeline
projects.tagline: Event-driven, serverless reconciliation for 12,000+ infrastructure resources.
projects.overview: An automated ETL pipeline built with Python and AWS Lambda that collects, transforms and validates infrastructure records from multiple data sources.
projects.problem: Infrastructure records arriving from several sources can contain duplicates, missing attributes and inconsistent values, which makes enterprise datasets unreliable.

architecture.label: Ingest
architecture.detail: Python on AWS Lambda collects infrastructure records from multiple data sources.

architecture.label: Trigger
architecture.detail: Amazon EventBridge runs reconciliation workflows automatically whenever asset information changes.

architecture.label: Validate
architecture.detail: Reconciliation logic flags duplicate records, missing attributes and inconsistent values.

architecture.label: Store
architecture.detail: Structured results are stored in Amazon DynamoDB.

architecture.label: Observe
architecture.detail: Amazon CloudWatch and Amazon SNS provide execution monitoring, exception tracking and notifications.

projects.technologies: Python, AWS Lambda, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon SNS
contribution: Designed and developed the ETL pipeline end to end.
Implemented the event-driven processing and DynamoDB storage model.
Wrote the validation and reconciliation logic.
Integrated monitoring, exception tracking and automated notifications.
results: Validation across more than 12,000 infrastructure resources.
Improved consistency and reliability across enterprise datasets.
resumeBullets: Designed and developed an automated **ETL pipeline using Python and AWS Lambda** to collect, transform, and validate infrastructure records from multiple data sources, improving consistency and reliability across enterprise datasets.

Implemented structured data storage using **Amazon DynamoDB** and event-driven processing through **Amazon EventBridge**, enabling automated execution of reconciliation workflows whenever asset information changed.

Developed data validation and reconciliation logic to identify duplicate records, missing attributes, and inconsistent values across more than **12,000 infrastructure resources**, improving the accuracy.
Integrated **Amazon CloudWatch and Amazon SNS** for execution monitoring, exception tracking, and automated notifications, supporting operational visibility and a reported **99.2% availability**.

projects.title: Production Data Monitoring and Quality Framework
projects.tagline: Catching bad records before they reach downstream reporting.
projects.overview: A Python-based framework that validates production records, detects processing anomalies and surfaces inconsistencies across backend data workflows.
projects.problem: Missing or inconsistent records in backend workflows can quietly affect downstream reporting and application processes if they are not caught early.

architecture.label: Validate
architecture.detail: Python checks validate production records and detect processing anomalies.

architecture.label: Handle
architecture.detail: Automated exception-handling workflows isolate missing or inconsistent records.

architecture.label: Visualize
architecture.detail: AWS CloudWatch and Grafana dashboards track application health, processing activity and operational metrics.

architecture.label: Improve
architecture.detail: Recurring failures are investigated and root causes documented with corrective actions.

contribution: Developed the monitoring framework and automated validation checks.
Built the CloudWatch and Grafana dashboards.
Investigated recurring processing failures and documented root causes.
results: Better visibility into system behaviour and production performance.
Issues identified before they affected downstream reporting.
Improved data reliability and troubleshooting efficiency.
resumeBullets: Developed a **Python-based data monitoring framework** to validate production records, detect processing anomalies, and identify inconsistencies across backend data workflows.

Built monitoring dashboards using **AWS CloudWatch and Grafana** to track application health, processing activity, and operational metrics, improving visibility into system behavior and production performance.
Implemented automated data validation checks and exception-handling workflows to identify missing or inconsistent records before they affected downstream reporting and application processes.
Investigated recurring processing failures and application issues, documenting root causes and corrective actions to improve data reliability, troubleshooting efficiency, and production support.

projects.title: Automated Health Checks and Deployment Validation
projects.source: Work at Community Dreams Foundation USA
projects.tagline: Release verification from ~40 minutes to under 10.
projects.overview: Python health checks and deployment validation scripts for cloud-hosted applications backed by AWS integration workflows.
projects.problem: Verifying each release by hand was slow, and the applications needed to stay reliable during periods of increased demand.

architecture.label: Deploy
architecture.detail: Cloud-hosted applications supported by Python backend services and AWS integration workflows.

architecture.label: Check
architecture.detail: Automated application health checks run after deployment.

architecture.label: Validate
architecture.detail: Deployment validation scripts confirm the release behaves as expected.

architecture.label: Monitor
architecture.detail: Grafana and Sentry surface recurring exceptions and performance issues.

contribution: Built the health check and deployment validation scripts.
Developed and maintained the backend services and AWS integration workflows.
results: Release verification reduced from ~40 minutes to under 10 minutes.
Deployment efficiency improved by more than 75%.
Supported a reported 10x increase in traffic.

projects.title: Secure API and Identity Integrations
projects.source: Work at Community Dreams Foundation USA
projects.tagline: REST, webhooks and single sign-on across connected services.
projects.overview: REST API and webhook integrations between connected services, secured with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SAML.
projects.problem: Communication and authentication failures between integrated applications needed to be traced to their root cause and resolved.

architecture.label: Integrate
architecture.detail: REST API and webhook integrations connect services and exchange payloads.

architecture.label: Authenticate
architecture.detail: OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML workflows handle authentication and authorization.

architecture.label: Debug
architecture.detail: HTTP requests, payloads, auth headers and logs are analyzed with Postman and curl.

projects.technologies: REST APIs, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, Postman, curl, Python
contribution: Developed and troubleshot the API and webhook integrations.
Implemented the authentication and authorization workflows.
Resolved token validation, access configuration and authentication failures.
results: Restored communication between connected services after integration failures.

projects.title: Enterprise Record Reconciliation Automation
projects.source: Work at South Carolina Department of Public Health
projects.tagline: ~15 hours of manual work removed every week.
projects.overview: Python automation and data validation workflows that reconcile enterprise records across an environment of more than 12,000 managed IT resources.
projects.problem: Finding missing attributes and configuration discrepancies across thousands of managed IT resources was a slow, manual process.

architecture.label: Collect
architecture.detail: Enterprise records gathered from the managed environment.

architecture.label: Reconcile
architecture.detail: Python workflows reconcile records and identify missing attributes.

architecture.label: Detect
architecture.detail: Configuration discrepancies are flagged for follow-up.

architecture.label: Report
architecture.detail: SQL Server and SSRS reporting give stakeholders operational visibility.

contribution: Developed the automation and data validation workflows.
results: Eliminated approximately 15 hours of manual work per week.
